title: Reboot to UEFI Firmware
name: reboot-to-uefi
modal: WARNING: Your PC will restart IMMEDIATELY into the BIOS/UEFI setup. Save all work first. Only change settings you understand (XMP/EXPO, Resizable BAR). Wrong BIOS settings can prevent Windows from starting.
description: Restarts the PC straight into BIOS/UEFI setup to enable FPS settings like XMP, Resizable BAR
deepDescription:
Windows cannot change BIOS settings directly, so this tweak restarts your PC straight into the UEFI firmware setup. Enable there for more FPS:

- XMP/EXPO → On (full RAM speed)
- Resizable BAR → On (more GPU frames)
- C-States/Power saving → Off (stable clocks)

WARNING: Do not change anything else. Wrong settings can stop Windows from booting.
warning: PC restarts immediately. Save your work first.
